Fun Toast started in 1941, by founders who mastered the craft of roasting Nanyang coffee and Singapore’s iconic charcoal grilled kaya toasts. This unassuming yet charming coffeeshop was first opened on Telok Ayer Street as Kheng Nam Hong, but has since evolved from a traditional family Coffeehouse to an innovative and uniquely Singaporean Coffeehouse.

description: Wine Connection is the leading chain of wine shops and wine-themed restaurants in South-East Asia. Established in 1998, Wine Connection has been developing expertise in wine for over 18 years.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Serving humble fare of coffee, tea, egg & toast, Ya Kun Kaya Toast is a cafe that exemplifies how less is more. The bread is generously slathered with our special kaya recipe that's stood the test of time. Get your breakfast fix.

name: Bynd Artisan
description: Bynd Artisan collaborates with artistic talents & stationery makers to celebrate the joy of traditional bookmaking and leather craftsmanship. Get your personalised paper and leather accessories.

name: MANGO

name: The Stamford Brasserie
description: This stylish tri-concept outlet, first in the hotel to run completely plastic-free, is conveniently located on the ground floor of Swissôtel The Stamford and comprises a Grab & Go, Bistro Restaurant and Beer Bar.

name: SKAI
description: Bringing to the fore a chic contemporary grill set in a new lifestyle and social dining destination, SKAI is located on the 70th floor of the iconic Swissôtel The Stamford and is prepped to become the go-to sky-dining establishment in Singapore.

name: GINLEE
description:
GINLEE Studio is an independent fashion house established in 2011 in Israel by Singaporean designer Gin Lee. Our creative platform is built on values of being true to yourself, being confident in who you are, being the best you can be. Our relaxed flattering silhouettes give today’s woman the comfort and uncompromised style, which they can work and certainly dance in. 
We work hard to keep our wearer's experience centred throughout our design process, while embedding our unique DNA that is influenced by our places, lifestyles and cultures. At GINLEE Studio, we believe in Making Fashion Matters.

name: S Lady
description: S Lady is a multi-label clothing and accessories retailer, based in Singapore. A shopping destination for the modern, dynamic and confident woman. S Lady have carefully curated a selection of quality contemporary pieces, providing women with day-to-night outfits for every occasion.

name: iStudio
description: iStudio offers a wide variety of Apple and third-party accessories that best complement your Apple devices, ensuring that you get the perfect pairing for the device you own.

name: Boarding Gate
description:
Boarding Gate offers a remarkably wide range of functional, fashionable and modern travel goods and accessories from world’s renowned travel brands catering to the needs of fashionable travellers as well as discerning shoppers looking for lifestyle accessories for everyday use.

High quality travel paraphernalia carried consist of daily essentials like easy-to-use travel containers, packing cubes and organizers, luggage, anti-theft bags, anti-RFID wallets, comfy neck pillows, water bottles, travel umbrellas to padlocks, luggage straps, travel soaps, travel adaptors, toiletry kits, lightweight packable totes/duffle/backpack, luggage portable weighing scale, compression socks, etc.

Worldwide brands from all-time favourites such as Bellroy, Bobby, Bric’s, Cabeau, Eagle Creek, Go Travel, Humangear, Klean Kanteen, Loqi, Osprey, Pacsafe, Thule, Victorinox,etc distinguishes Boarding Gate from the rest.

name: TOAST BOX
description: Toast Box is a coffeeshop favoured by locals. Come in and sit down for a fragrant cup of Nanyang coffee and toast, along with other local Singpaore delights.

name: BreadTalk
description: Perfect for busy professionals & shoppers alike, BreadTalk Cafe makes for a welcoming cosy venue to drop in for a quick breakfast meeting, lunch, leisurely teatime or dinner. Serves all-time comfort food such as Fish & Chips & Mushroom Carbonara.

name: Bengawan Solo
description: Bengawan Solo preserves the time-honored taste of Singapore's local kuehs & confectionery by using traditional methods, the finest & freshest ingredients, & absolutely no artificial preservatives to replicate this homemade quality in our bakes & light bites.

name: Spa Esprit
description: As Singapore’s favourite homegrown apothecary spa since 1996, Spa Esprit has always redefined the archaic spa space into a place for the mind, body and spirit to find serenity. From embracing new-age therapy to revisiting traditional techniques, Spa Esprit captures the best of both worlds to offer fresh alternatives to supply you with good vibes from the inside out.

name: Pablo Blau
description:
Immerse in an exclusive spa journey in our Signature Salt Rooms.

At Pablo Blau, we celebrate the art of beauty and the art of interpersonal service while seeking out the science from Mother Nature’s active ingredients for your skin and body through our Signature Salt Rooms. Pamper yourself with a facial in our Signature Salt Room today!

name: SKAI Bar

name: The Soup Spoon

description: British lifestyle brand known for its unique fragrance portfolio and luxury products for the bath, body and home. Rewriting the rules of perfumery by mixing unexpected combinations of ingredients and providing elegant yet playful concepts where scent is used with abandon, the world of Jo Malone London continues to inspire a loyal following.

name: Gingersnaps
description: Gingersnaps, built on a deep passion for creating trendy, global, fashion-forward designs for children and maternity wear, believes in creating a complete experience from the clothes, store setting, service, packaging and visual merchandising.

name: Kave Home
description: Birthed in Spain, Kave Home provides an extensive range of furniture and home décor filled with personality for your home, office and balcony. From sleek Scandinavian design to Mid-Century Modern, each piece is designed to provide sophistication to your space. Step into Kave Home, your home, where there's room for everyone.

description: At FortyTwo, we tasked ourselves to provide the best shopping experience ever for your furniture needs with over 20,000 items under an ever-broadening range of furniture, home decor and lifestyle items.. We strive to be the missing puzzle piece that puts together and completes your very own living space, a place you call home.

description: Maison Francis Kurkdjian was born in 2009 from the encounter between Francis Kurkdjian, a renowned perfumer with scores of successful creations to his name, and Marc Chaya, Co-founder and President of the fragrance house. Together, they fulfilled their desire for a sensual, generous and multi-facetted landscape of olfactory free expression, creating a new emblem of French know-how and lifestyle.

description: Founded in 1878 in Turin, Italy, Venchi brings over a century of chocolate-making heritage to your table. Indulge in authentic Italian chocolates and gelato, crafted from the finest ingredients. Enjoy a wide selection of plant-based and gluten-free options of premium pralines, iconic Chocoviar, artisanal spreads, and freshly churned gelato for a true taste of Italian tradition and sweetness.

name: & Other Stories
description: & Other Stories is a modern fashion brand that tells expressive stories. Collections are thoughtfully designed for everyday living and to inspire creative style and individuality worldwide.

name: LUCIA The Brownie Bar
description: Lucia Cakes’ owner and head baker trained in classical French patisserie at Le Cordon Bleu, London. The name LUCIA comes from her maternal grandmother, Lucy, who lived in St. Lucia’s Lane in Colombo and was the baker in the family. It was from her that Lucia Cakes’ owner learnt how to bake whenever she visited during her school holidays many, many moons ago.

name: Gucci Beauty
description: The boutique offers Gucci Beauty makeup alongside the House’s women’s and men’s fragrance collections.

name: NK BY NIKI
description: NKBYNIKI is a premium luxury FASHION label that conceptualise designs based on modern independent women. We focus on producing clothes that are FEMININE and ELEGANT, yet keeping it SIMPLE and CLASSIC, making it wearable for everyone. Discover premium ready-to-wear with NKBYNIKI — suitable for work, casual, or special occasions at the flagship store at Raffles City.

description: Mirage Aesthetic’s mission is to provide unparalleled service to their clients and journey with them in achieving their desired results through the aesthetic industry’s latest and most cutting-edge technology.

Our thoughtful range of lingerie, loungewear, and activewear prioritises quality and comfort that moves with you throughout your day. We unite the luxurious feel of our premium fabrics with innovative designs, fostering a state of ease and harmony, inside and out.

name: ZOK NOODLE HOUSE 竹麵館(港澳)
description: Founded in 2011 by four chefs, Zok Noodle House fuses the authentic cuisine from Hong Kong, Macau with our chef’s secret recipes, creating a delectable array of culinary delights that will captivate your palate. Our chefs ensure that every dish is prepared with passion and dedication, using quality ingredients. We seek to create an unforgettable dining experience for you at Zok Noodle House.

name: SURREY HILLS GROCER
description: Surrey Hills Grocer aims to be the most authentic Australian destination grocer by bringing you honest-to-good, fine, fresh products. Inspired by the harsh terrains of Australia, we strive to bring you the best produce and offer you a taste of warm Australian hospitality.

name: Kenangan Coffee
description: Kenangan Coffee is the fastest growing grab-and-go coffee chain from Indonesia, founded in 2017. It has over 850 stores in Indonesia, Malaysia, and is now available in Singapore. Kenangan Coffee is known for its Kenangan Blend coffee beans and signature Kenangan Latte.

name: LIV ACTIV
description: LIV ACTIV is a multi-sport lifestyle retailer for the contemporary athlete. The products sit at the intersection of performance sports and active lifestyle, enabling customers to traverse urban and natural landscapes with ease.

name: QB Premium
description: Experience the convenience of virtual queue system by simply scanning the QR code outside the store. This provide customer flexibility of not having to queue in line and return at a later time when it is about their turn.

name: HARNN
description: HARNN was born from a passionate craftsman’s heartfelt desire to enhance the way people care for themselves, doing so by creating high quality products. These humble origins continue to inspire HARNN today and are embodied in all we do. From creations crafted by nature to immersive store experiences, HARNN seeks to transform how people nurture their mind, body and soul.

name: BROTHERBIRD BAKEHOUSE
description: Brotherbird's first bake-on-site unit where customers can expect freshly baked croissants on an hourly basis. With a spread of 15 flavours daily, and with monthly specials, the menu is never the same.

name: Café&Meal MUJI
description: Café&Meal MUJI Singapore is dedicated to providing a selection of dishes made with these in mind — simplicity, quality, original, healthy and natural. Quality ingredients are key factors to great taste. Café&Meal MUJI sources from around the world to bring to you the best ingredients and seasonal vegetables used in the making of our hearty recipes. Dine with "Simple Food" that is gentle for your body, kind to the world and delicious, amidst the relaxing ambience at Café&Meal MUJI.

name: Breitling
description: Founded in 1884, Breitling is a leading Swiss watchmaker. The innovative company invented the modern chronograph and pioneered the navigational tool watch. The exceptional quality of every watch movement is confirmed by its status as a COSC-certified chronometer, and the brand remains one of only a handful of independent watchmakers to produce its own manufacture calibers.

name: Tissot
description: Tissot, with its signature 'Innovators by Tradition', has been pioneering craftsmanship and innovation since its foundation in 1853. The company has always had its home in the Swiss watchmaking town of Le Locle in the Jura Mountains but now also has a presence in 160 countries.

name: Real Yoga
description: At Real Yoga Studio, Yoga is not merely a passing trend, but an essential part of life. In line with this belief, our studio has developed its own unique approach known as the 4 Pillars, ensuring that Yoga is accessible to all who step through its doors. We invite individuals to embark on their Yoga journey and experience the transformative power it holds within.

name: 21 Medical Aesthetics Clinic

name: Victoria Beauty SPA
description: We strive to deliver quality, affordable, full-service skincare solutions that are formulated with active ingredients that create a healthier, longer-lasting result.

Aside from handcrafting designer leather goods and handbags, we are also a trusted supplier of the finest tanned leather for major fashion houses in Europe.

Since its founding, LAC, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control, has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

description: Bacha Coffee offers the largest selection of specialty coffees in the world, comprised of over 200 meticulously sourced 100% Arabica specialty-grade coffees from 35 of the most reputable coffee-producing countries. Guests may peruse their fine offerings of beautifully packaged coffees, gift hampers and timeless accessories for personal indulgence or to give as exquisite gifts. Commuting customers may delight in a bespoke takeaway experience that extends to their vast collection of over 200 specialty coffee, as well as housemade croissants and pastries — an effortless yet elegant way to enjoy the world's finest coffee on the move..

name: Converse
description: In some ways, you know us. Converse has been making Chuck Taylor All Star and One Star sneakers since we started over a century ago, and now we work to make new street style classics. What you wear defines sport, street, and creative culture, and we’ve been redefining it with you all along. When you wear Converse products, you create a culture of authentic street style simply by being yourself. Whether they’re on the feet of a '70’s basketball star in a history book or on the street with you today, Chucks have always signified cool...because you wear them. We don’t know where you’ll go, but we know you’ll take Converse to the future with you.

name: WO WO DIAN 窝窝店 百年包子
description: Wowodian, located in Mianyang, Sichuan, was founded in 1889, and has a history of over 130 years. Its unique feature lies in the fact that Wowodian always insists on making steamed stuffed bun with real Laomian (traditional sourdough). The technique of making Wowodian bun has been included in the Mianyang City catalog for the protection of intangible cultural heritage. Nowadays, Wowodian enriched its menu with many more traditional Sichuan cuisine, such as Mianyang rice noodle, mapo tofu, boiling water cooked sliced meat, and spicy and numbing chicken. Come and taste the flavors of one century ago.

name: Shiok Burger
description: Savour the Shiokness: Pleasure your taste buds at Shiok Burger, where you get to taste all premium ingredients at an affordable price! Shiok Burger's craft burgers are not just meals that fill your stomach but culinary Shiokness masterpieces.

name: Little Ground
description: Little Ground introduces an exclusive multi-brand concept store dedicated to providing top-notch kids' apparel, serving young toddlers up to 14-year-olds. Shop from a diverse selection of in-house Korean brands, such as Bluedog, Lulabee, Denim in the Box, Talescoop, and renowned global labels curated by international designers.

name: FILA KIDS
description: FILA KIDS, a premium children's sports and fashion brand under FILA, integrates the brand's elegant and dynamic Italian style into children's apparel. Incorporating functionality, FILA KIDS melds contemporary athletic aesthetics with paramount comfort attributes, catering to both young boys and girls.

name: Modelle
description: Modelle is a local brand established in 2015. Constantly evolving, we are dedicated to creating quality & unique pieces for you.

name: HOKA
description: HOKA® is one of the fastest-growing performance footwear and apparel brands in history. Conceived in the mountains, HOKA footwear delivers an unprecedented combination of enhanced cushioning and support for a uniquely smooth ride. Every day, HOKA pushes the innovation and design of its footwear and apparel by teaming up with a deep roster of world champions, taste makers and everyday athletes. From finish lines to everyday life, HOKA fans love the brand for its bold and unexpected approach, and its belief in the power of humanity to create change for a better world. HOKA empowers a world of athletes to fly over the earth.

name: M&G LIFE
description: At M&G LIFE, you can dive into a world of stylish stationery, perfect for writing your life stories. Find home decor items that turn your space into a beautiful and cozy haven. Check out our cool educational supplies that make learning fun for everyone. Enjoy designer toys that bring joy and creativity to both kids and adults. Try out the latest IT gadgets that keep you connected and entertained. Pamper yourself with beauty accessories that boost your style and well-being. Here, you will always find more than you ever expected, with each product designed to enrich and elevate your daily experiences.

name: Casa Vostra
description: With dishes that you would find in a traditional trattoria, we offer unapologetically Italian fare made from scratch and by hand, fresh from the kitchen everyday. From house-made pizza to hand-rolled pasta and house-cured charcuterie, nothing at Casa Vostra is over $30.

name: MoVida Singapore
description: At MoVida, we strive to bring you the vibrant flavours of Spain, crafted with passion, authenticity with the Melbourne Flair. Join us on a culinary journey where each dish tells a story, where every bite captures the essence of Spanish cuisine. Whether you’re here for our signature tapas, traditional paella, or our carefully curated Spanish wines and cocktails, we promise an unforgettable experience.

name: YSL Beauty
description:
Yves Saint Laurent launched his first makeup collection in 1978. Iconic makeup products such as Touch Eclat and Rouge Pur Couture helped to make Yves Saint Laurent the beauty hallmark that it is today. The signature gold cases and highly pigmented colours are testament to Yves Saint Laurent’s aesthetic.
As the man himself has been quoted saying, “A woman’s finest makeup is passion.” She is one who brushes aside taboos and dares to touch up her makeup in public, revealing the energy of her commitment to everyone around her.

name: Food Art
description: At Food Art, we make drinking soup easily accessible for you and your family. We curated convenient, nourishing, and delicious healthy eating with 100% natural ingredients without any artificial additives. Food Art is born to boost your health with our "Convenient & No-Cook" vegetarian nourishing soup to enhance your daily routine. No matter what your role is, Food Art has what you need.

name: LUMINE SINGAPORE
description: LUMINE SINGAPORE's global flagship store for the region at Raffles City showcases Japan's top fashion and lifestyle brands with a curated selection of women's and men’s fashion, along with cultural and lifestyle products. Highlights include collaborations with Japanese prefectures, starting with Fukui Prefecture’s traditional crafts with contemporary styles like Sabae City eyeglasses and Echizen City cutlery. Unique shop-in-shop experiences feature BEAMS, UNITED ARROWS, and TOMORROWLAND, alongside popular brands such as FRAY I.D, SNIDEL, And Couture, ELENDEEK, Spick & Span, and Le Talon. LUMINE SINGAPORE is also the launchpad for Blue Bottle Coffee's debut in Singapore, marking its first venture into Southeast Asia. The cafe offers a selection of merchandise, including their renowned Craft Instant Espresso and a variety of stylish drinkware and accessories. LUMINE SINGAPORE at Raffles City is more than just a store; it's a celebration of style, culture, and the endless possibilities of self-expression.

name: Armani Beauty
description: : Inspired by the fashion legacy of Giorgio Armani, the brand offers a wide range of cosmetics, skincare, and fragrances. Armani Beauty products are known for their exceptional quality, innovative formulas, and sophisticated packaging. From foundation to lipstick and from skincare to perfume, Armani Beauty presents a curated collection that allows individuals to express their style and enhance their natural beauty with a touch of luxury.

name: Mobilestop
description: We understand that your mobile device isn’t just a tool—it’s an extension of your personality and lifestyle. That’s why we curate a diverse selection of accessories that not only safeguard your device but also elevate its aesthetic appeal. Whether you’re upgrading to the latest smartphone or searching for a trendy case, Mobilestop is your trusted partner in mobile fashion and protection. Join us on this exciting journey, where style meets protection, and satisfaction is guaranteed. Welcome to Mobilestop—where your mobile accessory needs are our top priority.

name: ANTI:DOTE
description: At ANTI:DOTE, every item on the menu is crafted perfectly to appeal to the most discerning taste buds.

name: AXS Station
description: AXS Station is a one-stop multi-application and interactive self-service terminal that provides you with bills and fines payment services, government eServices, prepaid top-up, ticketing, and more.

name: CHARLES & KEITH
description: Charles & Keith curates a collection of stylish footwear and accessories for the fashion urbanites. Strut it with our designer handbags and always feel perfectly dressed!

name: Clifford Gems & Money Exchange
description: Clifford Gems & Money Exchange is a foreign currency exchange shop. Find the best exchange rate here.

name: DBS ATM
description: DBS ATM offers personal banking services such as cash withdrawal, funds transfer and more.

name: Drs Singh & Partners
description: Drs Singh & Partners Clinic offers medical consultation and related health & medical services.

name: Epid’or
description: The aroma from Epid’or bakery tempts you with freshly baked bread, cakes and other confectionery delights.

name: GODIVA Chocolatier
description: Godiva is easily distinguished by its quality craftsmanship along with superior ingredients like richly flavored Ivory Coast Cocoa Beans, Turkish Filbert Butter & fresh fruit fillings. Each exquisite chocolate creation is beautifully packaged - a feast for your eyes & taste buds.

name: JAAN BY KIRK WESTAWAY
description: Located on Level 70 of Swissôtel The Stamford, JAAN by Kirk Westaway takes guests on a multi-sensorial journey through Devon: each chapter unfolds as they make their way through the halls to the main dining area. The newly renovated 35-seat restaurant is further enhanced by the breathtaking views of Singapore’s scenic landscape as well as the truly exquisite culinary service experience.

name: Kim.T - Artsseni
description: Kim T is the bespoke designer of a fine jewellery collection. Our impeccable designs are available at Artsseni, a multi-brand designer store.

name: LAMY
description: Lamy is the leading German design brand for all your stationery needs. The idea of functional design is implemented in every detail of each product and all Lamy products meet the highest manufacturing standards of quality.

name: Lee Wee & Brothers' Foodstuff
description: Lee Wee Brothers' Foodstuff is a food kiosk that specializes in the Nyonya delicacy Otah and Nasi Lemak. Using the freshest seafood blended together with a homemade spice mix and then steamed in a fragrant pandan leaf wrap, who can resist this spicy goodness?

name: L'OCCITANE
description: Using only 100% natural essential oils and ingredients, L'Occitane retails skin care and body care products, fragrances, and home products.

name: Marks & Spencer
description: Marks and Spencer offers stylish, high quality, great value products, across womenswear, lingerie, beauty, menswear, childrenswear, foods and fine wines to suit every age, lifestyle and occasion.

name: NamNam
description: NamNam serves a variety of noodles, including Vietnam’s famous Pho, as well as savory Bahn Mi baguettes. Based on old-world recipes with a modern twist, our food transports diners to the vibrant streets of Vietnam.

name: O'Coffee Club
description: At O'Coffee Club cafe, sit down to an aromatic blend of premium roasted coffee beans. Taste the mellow bitterness that is perfectly balanced with a variety of spices infused in their coffee concoctions. The impressive menu includes signatures like the OCC Club Sandwich & Chili Crab Linguine.

name: Poulét
description: Poulet, french casual dining serving affordable and delectable dishes to the public.

name: PUTIEN Restaurant
description: PUTIEN Restaurant offers a wide range of stir fried dishes and innovative appetizers that will stimulate your palate. Signatures like Putien Lor Mee and Putien Bian Rou Soup showcase the culinary richness of Fujianese cuisine that will fill your stomach and heart.

name: Rolex at Cortina Watch
description: Immerse yourself in the expansive world of Rolex at our Raffles City store. Discover the fascinating qualities, innovations, craftsmanship and scrupulous attention to detail imbued in every Rolex watch. Opened in 2006, the Raffles City store marked Rolex’s first presence with Cortina Watch in Singapore. As you explore our fine selection of Rolex watches in comfort and luxury, our friendly and knowledgeable Sales Advisors are always on hand to attend to your every desire. Get acquainted with the legacies, innovations, and technical insights of every Rolex creation, and be pampered by our attentive, world-class customer service. Visit our Raffles City store today to start your journey into the world of Rolex.

name: Shahi Maharani North Indian Restaurant
description: Designed to remind you of royal palaces, tuck into the best of North Indian cuisine.

name: Singtel Exclusive Retailer
description: Check out the latest range of mobile phones and more at Singtel Exlusive Retailer! Get your mobile phone and sign up with Singtel for all your telecommunication needs. Stay connected and watch your favourite entertainment shows on the go.

name: Spa D'Or
description: Spa D'or has a wide range of massage therapies to suit you when you need just a little break from hectic schedules to relax, rejuvenate and relieve stress. From the signature Javanese massage to Hotstone massage or Chinese massage, let us massage those knotted muscles away.

name: Strip & Browhaus
description: Strip is a waxing boutique at the forefront of Brazilian waxing. Keeping things smooth, we offer quality service and advanced techniques when it comes to pre- and post-wax care. There are also complementary beauty treatments for the face and lashes available.

name: Tiong Bahru Bakery
description:
Better than ever at Raffles City.

Come by for a new look, self-serve pastries, fresh bakes and comforting hot dishes, all served with the buttery, flaky goodness you know us for!

Whether it’s your morning coffee run or an afternoon pick-me-up, there’s plenty to tuck into.

name: Watsons
description: Watsons, a Health & Personal Care chain, carries a variety of body wellness and beauty products to make looking good and feeling good convenient to all its customers. Now includes services such as medication dispensing.

name: Willow Stream Spa
description: Willow Stream Spa offers a variety of different authentically inspired massage, body treatments and facials for all your individual skin care needs using premium spa products. Store is not eligible for STAR$.

name: Wooloomooloo Steak House
description: Wooloomooloo Group has served sizzling premium steaks and time-honored favorites with the freshest ingredients and passion since 2004.

name: PS.CAFE
description: PS.Cafe offers brunches featuring cafe classics, famous truffle shoestring fries and indulgent cakes. Drop by its outlet at CapitaLand mall, Raffles City Shopping Centre.

name: KOI Thé Express
description: The only Milk Tea that’s so good you can actually tell them apart from the rest, KOI Café serves milk tea with a variety of standout toppings and exclusive flavours. Besides the bubble tea, try the Ovaltine Macchiato which exudes a malty aroma that balances the intense rich velvetiness of their Macchiato roast.

name: Tokyo Milk Cheese Factory
description: Tokyo Milk Cheese Factory creates unique sweets with carefully selected milk and high quality cheese, combined with ingredients from not only Japan, but also around the world.

name: TWG Tea Salon & Boutique
description: As the finest luxury tea brand in the world, TWG Tea commits to procuring its teas directly from source gardens. The brand’s tea collection is the largest in the world, with fine harvests from every tea-producing country. Internationally recognised as a true innovator, TWG Tea is celebrated for its extensive selection of exclusive handcrafted tea blends — including new blends of tea created every season in collaboration with the world’s most renowned estates. Exquisite signature contemporary tea accessories and delicate tea-infused sweets and savouries complete the TWG Tea experience.

name: Stuff'd
description: Stuff'd is a food kiosk that prepares deliciously grilled, naturally marinated chicken hand-rolled into an exploding wrap bursting with healthy greens and flavor. Get stuffed with this delicious mix of nutritional natural goodness.

name: Garrett Popcorn Shops
description: For over seven decades, Garrett Popcorn Shops has served gourmet popcorn using wholesome ingredients in their secret family recipes, passed down for generations. Custom grown, non-GMO butterfly and mushroom kernels are first hot-air popped in their kitchens, then enriched with flavor in seasoned, old-fashioned Copper Kettles. Because good things take time, Garrett Popcorn is handcrafted in small batches throughout the day.

name: Koji Sushi Bar
description: A trendy and casual Japanese sushi/sashimi-only joint with a simple menu focusing on quality fresh sea produce, speed and affordability in the day. In the evening, omakase is served with a good selection of sake/shochu for a relaxed dining experience.

name: CLOVE
description: Have your fill from a colourful display of vitality salads; fresh seafood on ice; smoked fish & charcuterie; breads; cheeses; and sweets. Not forgetting live stations of roasts and noodles; with an added decadent chocolate station on weekends.

name: Chopard at Cortina Watch
description: Chopard is internationally renowned for its timepiece and jewellery creations. Highly recognised for the Happy Sport timepiece, the maison is also celebrated for its Haute Joaillerie creations and expertise in the field of Fine watchmaking, as embodied in the L.U.C collection. Loyal to its fundamental values, Chopard is deeply involved in the work of various philanthropic organisations. Chopard is a longstanding partner of the Cannes Film Festival as well as prestigious classic car races, the Mille Miglia in Italy and the Grand Prix de Monaco Historique.

name: Wok Hey
description: If you like a good dish that brings out the heat and aroma of the wok, head down to the food kiosk Wok Hey, and experience the true stir fry with our signature Fried Rice, Ramen & Udon with your selection of toppings like Tobiko and Sous Vide Egg.

name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf
description: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf® is the oldest and largest specialty coffee and tea retailer in the United States, known for sourcing and providing the finest ingredients and flavours from around the world. The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf® is also Halal-certified.

name: UCHINO Bath & Relaxation
description: UCHINO is a renowned Japanese lifestyle brand who aims to deliver comfort, happiness, and pleasant sleep to consumers around the world through quality products using our patented materials.

name: Club21
description: Established in 1972, Club21 is Asia’s leading luxury fashion purveyor, instrumental in introducing iconic brands like Giorgio Armani, Prada, Dolce & Gabbana, and Calvin Klein to the region. Five decades on, Club21 continues to deliver stylish experiences and modern luxury solutions, representing brands such as AMI, ALAÏA, Alexander Wang, Jacquemus, Rick Owens, Simone Rocha, The Row, sacai, COMME des GARÇONS, Yohji Yamamoto, and more.

name: TUDOR at Cortina Watch
description: TUDOR is an award-winning Swiss-made watch brand, offering mechanical watches with sophisticated style, proven reliability and unmatched value for money. With origins dating back to 1926, the founder of Rolex, Hans Wilsdorf, registered the TUDOR brand with the mission of producing watches that respect the traditional Rolex philosophy of quality at a more affordable price point. Because of their robustness and affordability, throughout their history TUDOR watches have been chosen by the boldest adventurers on land, in the air, underwater and on ice.

name: Sun & Sand Sports
description: Since 1979, Sun & Sand Sports has grown leaps and bounds to become the largest sports retailer and distributor in the Middle East, with more than 200 stores across the region. Having established ourselves as a market leader, we’re bringing our vast portfolio of over 90 powerhouse brands to South-East Asia.

name: Cartier at Cortina Watch
description: As a leading retailer of luxury timepieces in the Asia-Pacific region, Cortina Watch is one of Cartier’s most important partners. This strategic partnership formed the basis of a strong distribution platform to showcase the Maison’s horlogerie collections, and introduced an entirely new audience of watch connoisseurs to Cartier’s timeless pieces.

name: MENSHO TOKYO SG
description: Mensho Tokyo, originating from Japan, is proud to open its first outlet in Singapore at Raffles City. Delivering to you ramen with a concept of “Farm to Bowl”, Mensho Tokyo SG uses local premium ingredients, crafted with love, passion and detail to create innovative dishes with a touch of local flavours.

name: Go Ba! 果霸茶
description: Get ready for a fruity fiesta with Taiwan’s fruit-tea sensation, renowned for our real fruit-infused teas, freshly blended fruit juices, and indulgent fruit smoothies that will make your taste buds go fruit-loopy. Go Ba! at Raffles City, our first international store, is the perfect place to enjoy your daily dose of fruity fabulousness.

name: TAG Heuer
description: TAG Heuer, founded in 1860 by Edouard Heuer in the Jura Mountains of Switzerland, is a luxury watch brand that is part of LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE (“LVMH”), the world’s leading luxury group.

name: Gyukatsu Kyoto Katsugyu 牛かつ 京都勝牛
description: Founded in Kyoto in 2014, Gyukatsu Kyoto Katsugyu serves only carefully selected lean cuts of beef, deep-fried quickly at a high temperature to the perfect medium rare. The secret to its crunch is its koromo batter, achieved through a secret blend golden ratio of bread crumbs, flour and egg wash. Finally, it is fried in fresh oil that is changed daily for clean, crisp flavours. Choose from a variety of cuts from the menu for your ideal beef katsu experience and employ multiple ways to enjoy its beef, complemented by a number of condiments and sauce.

name: Vivino
description: Vivino’s first retail store in the world at Raffles City brings you exclusive access to a curated selection of wines, featuring some of the top 1% as voted by Vivino’s global community. For the first time in Singapore, enjoy renowned global best-sellers such as Felix Solis Mucho Mas Tinto NV, Astrale Special Edition, and Hans Greyl Sauvignon Blanc.

name: Descente
description: Descente is a premium performance brand renowned for its innovative design, quality craftsmanship, and performance-focused sportswear. Since its founding, Descente has been dedicated to providing high-performance gear for athletes and sports enthusiasts around the world.

name: KILIAN PARIS
description: Founded 15 years ago by Kilian Hennessy, KILIAN PARIS counts today over 34 unisex fragrances within 5 olfactive families, all inspired by the founder’s olfactive memories and his passion for extravagant nightlife. KILIAN PARIS has been filled with unique perfumes, scented lipsticks, creative collaborations and crazy parties, embodying its motto: Don’t be shy. The brand represents 15 years of sustainability commitments through refillable perfumes that materialize its vision of timeless luxury.

name: Editions De Parfums Frédéric Malle
description: Launched in 2000, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle have revolutionized the global perfume industry, becoming an absolute reference. Rooted in a spirit of boldness and avant-garde, they have upheld, since their inception, the values of emotional and excellent perfumery.

name: Grand Cru, Wine Concierge
description: Grand Cru, Wine Concierge brings the top labels from Bordeaux to Burgundy and on to the New World to wine lovers and connoisseurs. With its experienced sommeliers and wine specialists, selecting wines has never been easier and more enjoyable. Grand Cru is your gateway to great wines.

name: SINGCHOICE Beauty & Health
description: At SINGCHOICE, we aim to inspire healthier and more beautiful lifestyles. Our commitment to quality is reflected in our carefully curated selection of beauty products, health supplements, and nutritious foods. We strive to create a space where innovation and well-being meet, offering our customers a unique blend of in-store and online experiences.

name: GO UNIQUE - 有间面馆 GO NOODLE HOUSE
description: Savour a diverse menu that fuses traditional flavors with modern culinary techniques featuring Rice in broth, Claypot rice, Bak Kwa Toasted Bun, made with carefully selected ingredients for an unparalleled taste.

name: Homm Dessert at Heart
description: A Melbourne-born Thai dessert cafe with the world's 1st and original Avalanche Bingsu. Homm, Dessert at Heart, hopes to bring you, your friends, and your family together for a sweet time. Founded by a husband and wife and their two friends. We are proud that our ingredients are professionally prepared from scratch using our own recipe with no food colouring or preservatives added. From the first bite of crumble to the last drop of whipped cheese, all from our hearts to yours.

name: SENZE Boutique Spa by Senze Salus
description: Since 2004, SENZE Boutique Spa by Senze Salus (formerly SK-II Boutique Spa) has led in skincare expertise, dedicated to enhancing holistic beauty and well-being through exceptional service. Spanning over 4,000 square feet, the flagship skincare spa is a wellness sanctuary, offering advanced skincare treatments that blend cutting-edge technology with personalized luxury. Today, Senze Boutique Spa sets new industry standards with innovative services and transformative experiences. As a purveyor of SK-II products in both retail and services, SENZE Boutique Spa remains committed to delivering the finest in skincare services.

name: Bon Broth
description: A groundbreaking dining concept by acclaimed Asian chef André Chiang, Bon Broth is set to redefine the hotpot experience with a unique fusion of French precision and Asian culinary traditions. Featuring a curated selection of eight standout broths, such as Sichuan Green Pepper, Satay, and Mala, each broth is a culinary masterpiece that enhances the natural flavours of the premium ingredients served alongside. With a seating capacity of 40, the restaurant’s design elegantly combines the sophistication of French fine dining with the warmth of Chinese culinary traditions, offering an intimate yet communal dining experience.

name: Bellezza Aesthetics
description: Bellezza, meaning “beautiful” in Italian, embodies our passion for enhancing natural beauty with luxurious, results-driven treatments. For over 13 years, our multi-award-winning medical spa has been trusted for innovative solutions tailored to the unique needs of Asian skin types. Our highly skilled beauty experts offer a wide range of specialised face, eye, body, and feminine health and wellness treatments, blending cutting-edge technology with personalised care. At Bellezza Aesthetics, we curate premium products and deliver exceptional results that inspire confidence and radiance.

name: DOMO Modern Japanese
description: Elevate your dining experience at DOMO Modern Japanese, where modern Japanese robatayaki meets a European twist. Delight in the exceptional freshness and natural sweetness of our seafood, paired with the rich, succulent flavours of premium meats, all expertly grilled over binchotan charcoal. Our robata grill, akin to the fire grill, delivers a perfect sear and a tantalising smoky aroma, while minimalist seasonings bring out the pure essence of each ingredient. Immerse yourself in an authentic and interactive dining adventure that showcases the finest ways to enjoy seafood and meat, whether raw or grilled.

name: Blue Bottle Coffee
description: Blue Bottle Coffee's first café in Southeast Asia at LUMINE SINGAPORE is where you can enjoy their signature coffee in an inviting space designed to reflect the brand’s commitment to craftsmanship, hospitality, and community. Each cup is brewed with precision to allow the delicate flavours of its single-origin beans to shine. Alongside its signature coffee, guests can enjoy a seasonally curated espresso menu, with beans sourced and roasted with the same level of care that has defined Blue Bottle’s reputation worldwide.

name: Penhaligon's
description: Penhaligon’s is perhaps the world’s most esteemed fragrance house, with a rich heritage interlaced with British history, aristocracy and culture. Since 1870, the fine perfumers have been entertaining the world’s nostrils with a dose of Britishness and dazzling scents, and they do not intend on stopping.

name: Fieldnotes
description: Fieldnotes is a brand rooted in nature and intention. We craft delicate, nature-inspired cakes that celebrate the beauty of seasons, textures, and flavours—designed for moments worth remembering. Each creation reflects our commitment to thoughtful design and quiet indulgence.

name: K-SWISS
description: Discover the spirit of California at K-SWISS, Raffles City Singapore. Founded in 1966, K-SWISS is a footwear brand focused on tennis from California, USA—best known for introducing the world’s first all-white leather tennis shoe. Loved for its clean, minimalist design and timeless appeal, K-SWISS continues to blend classic style with modern performance. Visit our Raffles City store and experience the perfect fusion of sport and style.

name: TARANIS
description: We serve as a professional high-end fashionable children shoes brand and focus on researching and producing products that meet the demands of children ranging from 0 to l8 years old in all categories, sizes and scenarios. We believe, "Shoes should be not only comfortable but also exquisite", and take this belief as our brand concept. We adhere to inheriting and carrying forward the consummate craftsmanship, and produce every pair of children shoes with the attitude to create a piece of luxury. We have scientifically categorised our products into six stages: The soft hugging shoes on Stage 0, the pre-walking shoes on Stage l, the toddler shoes on Stage 2, the kindergarten shoes on Stage 3, the medium- and large-sized children shoes on Stage 4 and the teenager shoes on Stage 5.

name: ARTEASG
description: ARTEASG is a fusion of "ART" and "TEA," symbolizing "Artistic Tea," with "SG" representing Singapore. Originating in Changsha, Hunan Province, but established in Singapore, it pioneered innovations such as Avocado Mousse, Biscuit-Infused Tea, and Organic Black Sugar Tapioca Milk. In 2017, it opened its flagship store at VivoCity and assembled its founding team. By 2019, ARTEASG launched its first domestic flagship store in Changsha, China. The brand’s signature "ARTEASG Blue" embodies purity, truth, and intuition, delivering an ultra-attractive, ultra-fresh, and ultra-delicious experience.

name: Nectarlife
description: Crafted with care using ethically-sourced, quality ingredients, each Nectarlife product is meticulously formulated to deliver a delightful experience.Our cruelty-free creations fill each day with sensorial delight and much-needed whimsy. Join our community and start nourishing your body and soul today!

name: SPICY NOODLE 銷魂麵舖
description: Spicy Noodles from Taiwan that will ‘Steal Your Soul’.

name: Welcia
description: Welcia Singapore is a leading health and beauty store dedicated to providing customers with premium Japanese and Korean products and services. Focusing on overall well-being, Welcia offers a carefully selected range of Japanese and Korean Beauty, Healthcare, and Wellness products, many of which are exclusive to Welcia Singapore.

name: Yan Sang Tang
description: At Yan Sang Tang, we are dedicated to offering premium Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) services tailored to meet the unique needs of each individual. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for holistic healing, we have become a trusted name in the field of TCM care.

name: Dior Beauty
description: When Christian Dior created his fashion house in 1946, he wanted women to rediscover joy, elegance and beauty. Today, his namesake label is synonymous with French luxury, appearing on haute couture, makeup, skincare and fragrances.

name: Club21
description: Established in 1972, Club21 is Asia’s leading luxury fashion purveyor, instrumental in introducing iconic brands like Giorgio Armani, Prada, Dolce & Gabbana, and Calvin Klein to the region. Five decades on, Club21 continues to deliver stylish experiences and modern luxury solutions, representing brands such as AMI, ALAÏA, Alexander Wang, Jacquemus, Rick Owens, Simone Rocha, The Row, sacai, COMME des GARÇONS, Yohji Yamamoto, and more.

name: V Aesthetics Hair Grow
description: No. 1 Hair Growth Expert, by Singapore’s largest aesthetic group, offers tailored solutions for hair loss. Using advanced technology and proven methods, we help restore fuller, healthier hair. Our personalised treatments and expert aftercare ensure long-lasting results. Regain your confidence today.

name: ALICE BOULANGERIE AND RESTAURANT
description: Basking in the spirit of the inquisitive and the adventurous Alice squirrel, our constant exploration and innovation in our savoir-faire lead us to the expansion of an entire Modern Contemporary gastronomical experience in Alice Boulangerie. Today, we are more than just your artisanal French bakery in this warm tropical hustle. Creating a unique and memorable experience for our guests lies at the very heart of Alice Boulangerie & Restaurant: we are on a mission to recreate the gastronomical experience of turning the usual into the exceptional for our guests.

name: The Food Place by Food Republic
description: Fresh new concept by Food Republic. Home to Michelin-recognised brands such as Li Xin Teochew Fishball Noodles, Ju Xing Fish, Kam's Roast Express and cult favourite brands such as SMASH by BurgerLabo, Mon Kee Cafe, Piao Mala, Penang Jiak, Hankang Pocha Korean Cuisine, PepperGrill, Go Teppan Go and more.

name: Books Kinokuniya
description: A curated bookstore offering a wide selection of English books and charming stationery. A welcoming space for readers and lovers of thoughtful design.

name: CHAGEE
description: CHAGEE is an international tea brand that brings traditional tea to modern life. Drawing from centuries of tea heritage, we craft premium whole-leaf brews that blend tradition with innovation — creating shared moments of connection, every day, in every cup. CHAGEE TOGETHER.

name: Niessing
description:
Fine Jewellery from Germany. Since 1873.
 
Heritage meets Innovation
Niessing, a renowned international luxury fine jewellery brand hailing from Germany, boasts a rich heritage spanning over 150 years since its inception in 1873. Recognised for its innovative designs, Niessing has been honoured with multiple prestigious awards and accolades such as the iF Design Award, Red Dot Design Award and German Design Award. Notably, the brand is celebrated as the inventor of the iconic Spannring®, the diamond solitaire of the modern age which features a 'floating' diamond without any setting.
 
Exquisite Gold Offerings for Every Skin Tone
Niessing made the colour wheel of gold come full circle with its 15 distinct shades of gold, each meticulously curated to complement a diverse array of skin tones. Explore the unique Niessing world of colours today!

name: PaperBakes
description: PaperBakes

name: KLARRA
description: Our mission is to provide value and inspiration to our community for an inspired, everyday living through creations with great attention to detail and quality, designed to be used and loved for a long time. We strive to grow alongside our community, putting you at the forefront and creating thoughtful, meaningful experiences and relationships with you. We wish to give everyone the freedom of expression through KLARRA, so we craft our aesthetics and products to accompany you in your everyday and through your different phases of life.

name: SABRINAGOH
description: SABRINAGOH continues to elevate the creative values of interplay between menswear and womenswear, conscious detailing and innovative exploration. Presenting an unfolding narrative in its years-long trajectory, the label has constantly danced between a pure, minimalist outlook and covert, playful subversion. Each collection is a meditation on a given theme, across an array of topics from the seasons to textiles, aesthetics, craft, patterns and architecture.

name: Edition
description: Edition embodies the spirit of the modern gentlewoman. Blending oriental influences with contemporary artistry, the collection features sophisticated, refined and timeless designs.

name: Sam Edelman
description: A creative visionary and legend in the footwear industry, Sam Edelman is a dominant force in fashion. Sam and his wife, muse and business co-founder, Libby Edelman, have grown Sam Edelman into a complete lifestyle brand. Since 2004, the Sam Edelman brand has been one of the most instantly recognizable affordable luxury brands. Inspired by timeless American elegance, Sam's innate understanding of the customer translates conceptually into a modern lifestyle informed by rich heritage, creativity and innovation.

name: Hermès Perfume and Beauty store
description: Hermès Perfume and Beauty store at Raffles City is the first in Southeast Asia. This new boutique embodies Hermès’ enduring philosophy of craftsmanship and creativity, offering an immersive journey into the world of Hermès Beauty and Fragrance.

name: Simply Wrapps
description: Simply Wrapps offers more than 45 healthy and tasty Chef Creations in the form of Wraps, Salads, Bowls, Quesadillas and Burritos to nourish your body and mind. You can also Make Your Own from a selection of more than 45 healthy ingredients (rich in fiber and vitamins; prepared on daily basis) and 11 House Dressings. As such, your options are countless! All Simply Wrapps Cafés are Muis Halal-certified. Simply Wrapps makes healthy food and beverages tasty and affordable.

name: MO&Co.
description: Modern, edgy and effortlessly chic — MO&Co. delivers fashion-forward designs for the confident, independent woman. Focusing on quality and design innovation, each collection blends modernity with an urban edge.

name: BLUEBIRD TRAVEL 青鳥旅行
description: Bluebird Travel 青鳥旅行 was founded in Taiwan in 2015 and is renowned for its signature Filled Egg Rolls. As the first to introduce the Pork Floss Filled Egg Roll, the brand has since developed creative flavours such as Taiwan Tea Tieguanyin, 85% Dark Chocolate, and Pearl Milk Tea, redefining the classic egg roll with modern craftsmanship. Bluebird Travel has been recognised among Taiwan’s Top 30 Bakery Awards and Taichung’s Top 10 Souvenirs, and proudly served as an official gift partner of the Golden Horse and Golden Bell Awards — embodying the perfect balance of artistry and craftsmanship. Continuing to explore the “100 Possibilities of Egg Rolls”, Bluebird Travel brings 100 Possibilities of Happiness to every food lover’s daily moments.

name: TALAD THAI BANANA
description: Talad Thai Banana is an Authentic Thai recipe crafted with love. Our main outlet is at Thai Supermarket — our unique batter is made from the freshest ingredients prepared daily with love and good intentions. All products are vegetarian friendly and in fresh batches daily.

name: YeoMama Batik
description: YeoMama Batik is a vibrant apparel and lifestyle brand that reimagines traditional batik with an effortlessly fun, colourful, and refreshing twist. Founded in 2018 and thoughtfully designed in Singapore, our creations celebrate everyday people — because everyone, regardless of age or body shape, deserves to look good and feel even better.

name: Amouage
description: Amouage is a luxury fragrance house renowned for creating some of the most finely crafted perfumes in the world. Founded in the Sultanate of Oman to be ‘The Gift of Kings’, the House has redefined the Arabian art of perfumery and garnered a reputation for bringing innovative modernity and true artistry to all its creations.

name: Lulucrystalsx
description: At Lulucrystalsx, we redefine crystal jewellery with a modern touch. Proudly recognised as Singapore’s top choice for exquisite crystal accessories, all our pieces are crafted using 100% natural crystals. Every bracelet is thoughtfully designed and meticulously handcrafted in-house, right here in Singapore. Our exclusive designs blend elegance with intention, making each piece not only beautiful but truly one-of-a-kind. Discover crystal jewellery that speaks to your soul, and supports your intentions — only at Lulucrystalsx.

name: RABEANCO
description: RABEANCO traces its roots to 1980s Milan, where it began as a family-run atelier specialising in premium leather accessories for men. Following notable success exporting to East Asia in the mid-1990s, the brand evolved into a refined fashion house with a primary focus on handbags — now embraced predominantly by a discerning female clientele. Designed between Hong Kong and Singapore, RABEANCO is now present in major cities across East and Southeast Asia.

name: SOPHIA
description: Founded in Singapore in 2015, SOPHIA® (formerly The Sophia Label) creates thoughtfully designed bags for real everyday life. Each piece is made to feel effortless to carry, with practical compartments, lightweight comfort, and timeless style you can rely on from work to weekends. Designed with intention and quality craftsmanship, SOPHIA® bags are made to move with you, wherever your day takes you.

name: ROYCE'
description: Producing quality artisanal chocolate that melts in your mouth, ROYCE' is dedicated to making chocolate of world-class quality. The signature product, Nama Chocolate is a fine, delicate combination of selected chocolate and fresh cream with a hint of prestige liqueurs. Liqueur-free versions are available as well while seasonal Nama Chocolates are made in limited quantities.

name: H. Moser & Cie at Cortina Watch
description: As a fully integrated independent manufacturer for nearly 200 years, H. Moser & Cie. has built a legacy of quality, craftsmanship and exclusivity. H. Moser & Cie. is able to ensure that every hand-made watch corresponds to the values of the brand. From designing and producing our very own in-house mechanical movements, to the intricate reshaping and hardening of each individual hairspring, every resulting hand-made watch is a true work of art.

name: Sushidan
description: The first Singapore store of Michelin-starred Japanese chef Hiroyuki Sato's Sushidan is here at Raffles City with à la carte sushi starting at $1.99 per piece, handrolls from $3.99 each and omakase sets from $19.90.

name: Dressing Paula
description: Rooted in the power of women embracing their higher purpose, Dressing Paula’s journey began with a simple intention: designing timeless classics that speak to today’s multifaceted, multitasking woman. The ethos still grounds the brand’s creation process—now underscored with a new name: “Little luxuries, big impact.”

name: Taste Ipoh
description: Taste Ipoh brings the warmth and comfort of Ipoh’s hometown flavours into the heart of the city. Discover a thoughtfully curated menu showcasing Ipoh classics such as the award-winning tender Shredded Chicken Horfun, aromatic Nasi Lemak paired with crispy Ayam Goreng Berempah, and the city’s much-loved Ipoh Traditional Crispy Popiah. To complete the experience, enjoy freshly brewed Ipoh White Coffee made to order — rich, smooth, and beloved by coffee enthusiasts everywhere.

name: KKV
description:
KKV, the first flagship brand of KK GROUP, was established in 2019. It has become one of the most popular anchor stores in shopping centres and is committed to providing products for a variety of exquisite lifestyles. 

Brand characteristics:
  1. Good to shop: 10 major product categories (Daily Use, Food & Beverage, Trendy Toys, Makeup, Beauty Tools, Clothings & Accessories, Stationery, Home Essentials, Skincare, etc.)
  2. Good looking: 18 themed scenes
  3. Good to play: 20000 SKUs for various lifestyles

name: Prada Beauty
description: A brand of perpetual exploration and reinvention, Prada Beauty challenges perspectives and the status quo to serve as a precursor and pioneer, with a perspective of uncompromised quality, radical elegance, intellectual purity and freedom of creative experimentation.

name: UOB ATM
description: UOB ATMs offer convenient personal banking services such as cash deposit & cash withdrawal.

name: SEUNG TAE
description: Immerse yourself in a world where beauty meets sophistication. Discover our curated selection that defines elegance, with each product crafted to enhance your natural allure and elevate your daily rituals.

name: ThaiExpress
description: Certified for its authenticity, Thai Express is a restaurant that dishes up spicy tangy Thai favorites like Tom Yum Seafood Soup and Seafood Phat Thai. Their concept is inspired by the needs of customers who want to dine amidst a relaxed yet contemporary ambience and enjoy Thai cuisine at very reasonable prices.

name: sio pasta
description: sio pasta is a casual Italian restaurant by Tokyo-based chef Shusaku Toba, whose flagship brand sio has been recognised in the Michelin Guide. Making its first appearance outside Japan in Singapore, sio pasta serves handcrafted pastas from $13.80, created with a focus on balance, clarity, and natural flavours. Using house-made dough, seasonal ingredients, and precise technique, the restaurant offers an approachable yet refined dining experience that reflects Chef Toba’s philosophy that great food is shaped not only by ingredients, but also by space, atmosphere, and thoughtful simplicity.

name: Longchamp
description:
Authenticity, sincerity, energy, optimism are the values that remain at the heart of Longchamp.

Artistic Director, Sophie Delafontaine perpetuates this heritage and develops her vision of the authentic Parisian woman. Her style is fluid, natural , with “joie de vivre” for a contemporary and cosmopolitan customer. Longchamp reinvents French elegance with a twist.

Convinced that sustainability is an important component of manufacturing excellence, Longchamp’s teams have always brought respect and attention to their products. Since 2019, the use of recycled fabrics has been introduced into the Le Pliage® line, with the goal now achieved since the end of 2022 of transitioning from the use of virgin polyamide to recycled polyamide throughout the entire Le Pliage® collection.

name: By Invite Only
description: Founded in 2009, we’re an omni-channel, direct-to-consumer brand with a purpose to evoke meaning & connection through jewellery. Our pieces are crafted with intention and care for women who seek to deepen connections, transforming memories into cherished treasures in an era of conscious consumerism.

name: Wilson
description: Founded in 1914 in Chicago, Illinois, Wilson Sporting Goods Co. is a leading manufacturer of high-performance sports equipment, apparel, footwear, and accessories. With more than a century of innovation, history, and heritage across multiple sports, including tennis, baseball, padel, football, basketball, volleyball, pickleball, and golf, Wilson’s equipment, game balls and apparel are thoughtfully designed and developed to empower athletes at every level around the world to perform at their best.

name: arena
description: The Arena Concept Store boasts an extensive range of practical yet sophisticated swimwear and accessories that vary in design and function. Swimmers are sure to find the swim wear that best suits their needs.

name: Artary
description: Artary

name: Better Vision

name: BreadTalk

description: Confucius Mandarin

Cotton On’s style is effortless, lived-in and accessible to everyone. Inspired by the everyday guy and girl with an eye for the latest trends and a drive for self-expression. From day one, Cotton On has always been about people and community, and doing good along the way.

description: Founded in 1970, Lee Hwa is one of Asia's leading contemporary fine jewellers in Singapore, introducing diamond and gold statement jewellery for everyday and occasion wear. An expert on diamonds, Lee Hwa introduced Destinée, The Perfect Diamond, to the APAC region. The brand also welcomed ITALGOLD, artisanal 916 Gold perfected by fine Italian craftsmanship, to its oeuvre of gold jewellery which includes the world's first 19k solid Purple Gold. Lee Hwa is also the exclusive distributor of world-renowned brands such as De Beers Forevermark, Niessing, Fabergé and Stenzhorn.

description: A simple greeting of LiHO is a great way for individuals to bond and it is even better with a cup of Singapore’s home grown tea brand, LiHO TEA.

description: Feeling stressed out, stiff & sore from a day of sitting in office? Take a moment to retreat into a centre of calm. OTO's relaxation solutions of massage chairs & foot massagers transform your home or office into a blissful sanctuary.

name: TOAST BOX
description: Toast Box is a coffeeshop favoured by locals. Come in and sit down for a fragrant cup of Nanyang coffee and toast, along with other local Singpaore delights.

name: TOG
description: TOG retails series of video games and action figurines to cater to the gaming enthusiasts and passionate collectors in Singapore.

name: Tori-Q
description: Tori Q is a food kiosk that transforms a simple chicken chunk on a stick into chargrilled goodness on a stick with our Yakitori selection. Generously coated with our special Tare sauce to give that savory sweet caramelization, Tori Q is a BBQ upgrade.

name: Watsons

Designed to be of the time and for the time, LifeWear is made with such modern elegance that it becomes the building blocks of each individual’s style. A perfect shirt that is always being made more perfect. The simplest design hiding the most thoughtful and modern details. The best in fit and fabric made to be affordable and accessible to all. LifeWear is clothing that is constantly being innovated, bringing more warmth, more lightness, better design, and better comfort to people’s lives.

name: N20 Beauty & Eyelash
description: N20 Beauty & Eyelash indulges customers with a one-stop nail spa experience that encompasses a host of services including manicure, pedicure, eyelash extension, eyebrow embroidery and waxing.

name: OWELL
description: OWELL Bodycare helps you discover the wonderful ways you can harness your body's natural healing power with the quality BIO-Ge Titanium Health accessories. Explore the therapeutic and rejuvenating healthcare products which help to relax and soothe muscle aches.

description: Tech House exclusively offers better customer experience with full range of international brands product. Our premium brand range include audio, mobile phone/tablet/laptop accessories, new charging solution, car related accessories, portable projector, home entertainment system, smart home product, IT peripheral and more.

name: Gokoku Japanese Bakery
description:
Originating from Kobe, Japan, Gokoku Japanese Bakery is an authentic Japanese ‘wa’ (和) bakery boasting a heritage in bread production since 1961. Gokoku Japanese Bakery stays true to using established Japanese techniques and quality ingredients sourced from Japan to produce hearty, wholesome buns that are freshly baked daily.

The use of nourishing ingredients abundant in minerals is believed to contribute to the happiness and health of customers, ultimately leading to good fortune. Signature Gokoku Shichifuku Pan (五穀七福) – translating to "5 grains and 7 fortunes" in Japanese – is a soft, chewy dough crafted from hearty grains that provide essential daily nutrients, and is a must-try item.

name: The Care
description: The Care Laundry Services provides top-notch laundry and dry cleaning solutions at unbeatable rates.

name: Aēsop
description: Aesop was established in Melbourne in 1987. Our objective has always been to formulate products of the finest quality. This includes skin, body, and hair care, as well as fragrance and accessories for self and space. We explore widely to source plant-based and laboratory-made ingredients, using only those with a proven record of safety, efficacy and pleasure. Our products are available online, at Aesop signature stores in many major cities, department store counters, and in shared spaces around the world.

name: LAC Nutrition for Life
description: LAC, a subsidiary of V3 Brands, is a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence. Since its founding, LAC, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control, has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

Wingstop’s menu also features signature sides including Voodoo fries, hand-breaded mushroom fritters, and our famous freshly-made ranch dip.

name: Oakley
description: Oakley was created for world-class athletes, those who see the limits of possibility as just another challenge. Their dedication drives Oakley to look beyond the conventional ideas of industry standards. Oakley DNA is to identify problems, create inventions, and wrap those inventions in art. And simply to make things better than anyone thought possible. These categories include sunglasses, optical prescription glasses, apparels and accessories from cycling, golf, snow, training and lifestyle.

description: PRISM+ is Singapore’s fastest-growing consumer electronics brand. Known as the country’s #1 TV and Monitor brand, it has recently become the first local brand to launch its own Smart Air Conditioner System, Smart Ceiling Fan, Smart Air Purifiers, and Refrigerators. With a reputation for delivering wallet-friendly products that are packed with features and backed by award-winning customer service, PRISM+ continues to define the future of smart home technology.

name: Modparade
description: Discover Modparade, where we believe that magic happens when you are doing what you love the most. We love creating enduring, high-quality clothing designed for both comfort and style. Our thoughtful designs are suitable for all occasions, meticulously crafted to perfection. From the precise cut of each piece to their seamless assembly, every detail matters. Explore our collection at the Funan pop-up store and experience the magic of Modparade.

description: Noodle Star K is the first restaurant in Singapore to serve handmade cold noodles (NaengMyeon). Naengmyeon (冷麵, culture language: Langmyeon) is one of the unique changuksu dishes on the Korean Peninsula. Boiled noodles are put in cold broth and topped with seasoning and garnish.

name: Dapur Penyet
description: Established in 2005, we serve quality, authentic Indonesian food at value-added prices. We offer a variety of sambal with different levels of spiciness to cater to every taste bud.

name: Omnidesk
description: Explore our range of award-winning standing desks at Omnidesk and reimagine your workspace with nature's beauty. The Omnidesk Pop-Up Store spotlights our entire range of solid wood table tops, featuring crowd-favourites Pheasantwood and Walnut, as well as the one-of-a-kind Ichi Collection table tops. These table tops preserve the signature characteristics of each solid wood, thus maintaining the durability, resilience and aesthetic customers look for in solid wood furniture. Omnidesk was born from a simple vision: to help users transform the way they work by building more ergonomic workspaces. At the heart of this transformation is the Omnidesk standing desk.

name: Astute Medical Clinic
description: Astute Medical Clinic offers various aesthetic solutions administered by a dedicated team of experienced medical doctors and consultants. All treatments are focused on enhancing natural beauty with state-of-the-art technology and medical expertise.

name: Clippers Barber
description: Clippers Barber

name: Now Pizza
description: NOW Pizza: Unleashing Flavour in 90 Seconds. Once upon a time in the heart of culinary innovation, NOW Pizza was born. A revolution in the realm of pizza, where time meets taste in a mouthwatering crescendo. At NOW Pizza, we believe in more than just pizza; we believe in a slice of life served fast and flavourful.

name: Brompton Junction
description:
First invented in 1975 by young engineer, Andrew Ritchie, each of the Brompton bike represents remarkable skilled craftsmanship. Till today, it is made by hand in the United Kingdom. With nearly half a century's worth of expertise in manufacturing the folding bike, each Brompton is iconic for its ease of fold, portability, and versatility across cities today.  

Our purpose is to create urban freedom for happier lives. Through relentless innovation, we have expanded our presence across global cities, and we are proud to be the world's favourite and the largest bicycle manufacturer in Great Britain.

name: Dreame
description: Dreame's technological journey began in 2015 with our founding team's pioneering work on high-speed digital motors. Evolving into intelligent algorithms, Dreame creates distinctive products such as robot vacuums, wet and dry vacuums, sticks vacuum and hair dryer that bring joy to users worldwide. Our extensive patent filing portfolio reflects our dedication to pushing technological boundaries.

name: Happy Cup
description: Founded in 1996, Happy Cup rebranded our brand to promote healthy, fresh, and tasty teas brewed right on the spot. Our taro paste, boba pearls, and small taro balls are all handmade without any colorings or preservatives, while our fruit teas are made with fresh juices from the farms of Taiwan - definitely a healthier choice for all you bubble tea lovers!

name: Kopi & Tarts
description: “Kopi & Tarts” is a local Halal coffee concept, where we marry the love of coffee with our freshly baked tarts and pastries. We aim to delight the palate with both sweet and savoury offerings, allowing family, friends and loved ones to take a break and enjoy the simple pleasures in life.

name: Alchemist & Arcade
description: Coffee meets fashion at Alchemist & Arcade, where you can enjoy quality brews alongside curated fashion selections. A space where individuals can find common ground, exploring the best of both worlds under one roof.

name: Mincheng Bibimbap
description: Mincheng Bibimbap 민정비빔밥 敏丁拌饭 is a renowned establishment specializing in Chinese Korean ethnic cuisine, offering a unique blend of flavors that reflect the rich culinary heritage of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture in China. Since its inception in 2008, Mincheng has expanded globally with over 400 outlets worldwide. Our menu boasts a diverse range of dishes, with the iconic Mincheng Bibimbap taking center stage. In addition to this signature dish, we offer Stone Plate series and a selection of savory soups inspired by Chinese Korean traditions. Complementing these are complimentary offerings like Rice Kimchi and seaweed soup, ensuring a complete and satisfying dining experience. Explore the flavours of Chinese Korean cuisine today.

name: Seoul Bunsik
description: Discover Authentic Korean Street Food. Savour the heart of Seoul with our freshly prepared Tteokbokki, Kimbap, Korean fried chicken, self cooking Ramyeon and more at Seoul Bunsik. Dive into a menu that blends traditional flavours, and experience Korea's vibrant food culture right here in Singapore.

name: The Upper House
description: The Upper House Grill & Bar offers an unparalleled culinary experience for those seeking delectable grilled dishes pair with an extensive selection of craft beverages. Enjoy our grilled culinary delights which we are sourced from the finest local ingredients, to ensure a dining experience that is both memorable and satisfying. Whether you are a connoisseur of aged whiskies, fine wines, or prefer signature cocktails, our bar is a haven for those who appreciate the art of a well-poured drink.

name: Mingle
description: At Mingle Bistro, connections are made over great food and drinks. Be it a social gathering, families having a weekend bonding, or fitspo recharging after a workout, we are here for you. Mingle offers a variety of cuisines and beverages where we fuse Italian and Asian flavours to create delectable food, transforming meals into unforgettable dining experiences. Our signature hot stone pizzas are freshly baked, arrive on your table piping hot and remain warm while you mingle and chat. There’s always great food, great company and great stories to be shared — not forgetting laughter too!

name: Hallyu Hair
description: On the streets of Seoul, hair is not just a physical feature, but a dynamic reflection of one's identity, creativity, and artistry. At Hallyu Hair, we are more than just cutting, colouring, and treating hair. We will elevate your own style, crafting a unique look and a hairstyle that wears your personality. "HALLYU 한류" pays homage to the Korean Wave, symbolizing the global phenomenon of Korean culture and beauty.

name: Ajumma's
description:
Experience the bold and vibrant flavours of Ajumma’s Korean dishes, from savoury, smoky cuts of beef, to heartwarming bowls of rich kimchi broth, you are definitely in for a treat! Made from scratch daily with the freshest ingredients and seasoned with love, Ajumma's will leave you feeling full in your bellies and in your hearts.

We're still open for takeaway/delivery!

name: Brompton Junction (Workshop)
description:
Brompton Junction is our flagship store located in key cities around the world with a wide range of Brompton bicycles. At our workshop, we provide service and maintenance for your cycling needs. It is also an exclusive space for our Brompton community to gather and network. Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or a casual rider, our dedicated team is committed to providing top-notch service to keep your Brompton well-tuned and running smoothly.  
 
Our skilled mechanics perform rigorous safety checks as well as a comprehensive assessment of your bike, fine-tuning it for optimum performance. From basic tune-ups to complex repairs, we've got you covered with precision and attention to detail. We only use genuine, quality-tested parts straight from our London Factory, that you can trust.  

Visit us today.

name: Dal.komm COFFEE
description: Founded in South Korea, dal.komm COFFEE is a trendy lifestyle entertainment coffee chain gaining traction globally. Rising to international popularity for its featured appearance in several scenes of the hit Korean TV DRAMA, Descendants of the Sun, Goblin and Mr Sunshine, the café has since become a go-to spot for Korean fans and regular Singaporean alike. dal.komm COFFEE offers a unique selection of coffee blends categorised into K1, K2, K3, K4, all of which made from exclusively-sourced Arabica bean blends. Each blend has its own unique profile and characteristics, shining in its own right. For instance, the K1, comprises of a blend of Brazil and Costa Rican beans served in frozen cubes whilst temperature-controlled milk; the creaminess of the coffee slowly thickens and intensifies as the ice gradually melts. So treat yourself to quality coffee at dal.komm COFFEE’s outlet at CapitaLand mall, Funan. Be greeted by a cosy and welcoming ambience, with songs and tunes that were used in popular Korean Drama series playing in the background.

name: DUNKIN' DONUTS
description: Dunkin' Donuts is Singapore’s favourite all-day stop for great coffee and baked goods. Visit us to enjoy a fantastic selection of donuts including all-time favourites Mr Happy, Boston Kreme and Strawberry Filled Donut, as well as delightful limited edition options.

name: Flavours by Saute
description:
Flavours by Sauté is the latest venture by Sauté and serves fusion vegetarian and vegan food in Singapore. They aim to create a homely and cosy environment for families and friends to bond over an enjoyable meal. Whether your lifestyle gears towards veganism, health conscious diets or anything in between, Flavours by Sauté has something for you.

 

Flavours by Sauté crafts their food from natural ingredients that are wholesome, nutritious and of the best quality. All their dishes do not contain garlic or onion, and are meat-free. One of their bestsellers is the Orh Luak, which comes in Sichuan Mala, Quinoa and the chef recommended Truffle flavour as well. Give their Nyonya Otah Cutlet Quinoa Rice a try, it is free of mock-meat and offers house-made baked Nyonya Otah Cutlet instead! Their Laksa Lion Mane Spaghetti is a popular choice and Singapore fan favourite as well, with a creamy, nostalgic Laksa base and sautéed lion mane mushrooms for a chewy touch. To round up your meal, the Gula Melaka Latte and Caramel Swiss Carrot Cake with Ice-cream are good choices to indulge in.

 

Visit Singapore’s Flavours by Sauté for great tasting Earth-based cuisine today!

name: GODMAMA
description: Godmama is a modern Peranakan restaurant for guests who are looking for an uplifting and lively dining experience. Helming the Godmama Kitchen is Peranakan Head Chef Fredric who will be faithfully recreating Godma's traditional family recipe and signature classics.

description: Guardian takes care of all your beauty and personal care needs with a range of health care, skin care and beauty products while our in-store specialists offer customers expert advice and support. We also provide professional services such as patient-care counselling and dispensary services at our pharmacies.
