description: JD is the leading specialised trainer and sports fashion retailer from the UK. Known for their massive collection of exclusives and limited releases from the biggest and greatest brands such as adidas, Nike, New Balance, Vans, and many others, JD has been dedicated in bringing the most anticipated trainers to the sneaker scene for well over 30 years. They are, after all, the Undisputed King of Trainers.

Let our highly skilled therapists specially craft out your needs to relax, revive and rejuvenate your body, soul and mind.

Our slow but meticulous cooking process allows the different ingredients to develop into a hearty richness like no other. description: At Elite Supplements Singapore, we’re committed to empowering individuals to reach their goals and push past their limits. We offer personalised treatments like meridian massage, gua sha, and calming aromatherapy designed to ease tension, regulate the body, and support restorative sleep. Rediscover the power of rest, naturally.

name: Pure K 纯K
description: Pure K is a next-generation KTV brand that fuses music, culture, dining, and entertainment into a fully immersive experience. The cutting-edge private rooms double as tech-driven social spaces, with large-format immersive screens and dynamic scene-switching for a stunning audiovisual experience. Guests can enjoy authentic Taiwanese dishes—freshly prepared and perfect to savor while singing. With a vast global music library updated in real time, there’s a track for everyone. More than a hotspot for trendsetters, Pure K is ideal for private parties, lively gatherings, and even sports screenings — your one-stop destination for unforgettable karaoke moments.

name: allbirds
description: Named "The World’s Most Comfortable Shoe” by TIME magazine, Allbirds is redefining comfort with shoes made from nature. Known for using sustainable materials like merino wool, eucalyptus tree fiber, and sugarcane, Allbirds crafts everyday footwear that’s light on your feet and light on the planet. Designed for all-day wear, each pair combines simplicity, comfort, and low environmental impact. From their iconic Wool Runners to performance-ready Tree Dashers, Allbirds delivers style and substance in equal measure. As a certified B Corp, the brand champions responsible business and carbon reduction. Step into comfort with purpose—because better shoes make a better world.

name: Khao

The kind you could eat every day without thinking twice. Years later, with a few friends and a craving for the flavours of home, they reimagined the fast-casual experience- with an Asian twist. Built on the belief that delicious, balanced meals should be both accessible and aesthetic, Khao was born.

name: Pixie Nail Spa
description: Pixie Nail Spa offers a premium beauty experience, specialising in manicures, pedicures, lash extensions, brow embroidery, and more. With a team of expert beauty technicians and a strong commitment to quality, we provide exceptional service in a clean, comfortable, and relaxing environment. Whether you're looking for elegant nails, stunning lashes, or flawless brows, Pixie Nail Spa ensures every visit leaves you feeling pampered and polished. Visit us to indulge in luxurious beauty treatments designed just for you.

name: Yuen Kee Dumpling
description: Founded in 2012, Yuen Kee Dumpling is a brand under China Yuanji Food Group Co., Ltd., specializing in handmade Cantonese dumplings and wontons. With a focus on freshness and quality, each dumpling is freshly wrapped and cooked, combining tender fillings with soft, chewy skins. Known for signature items like the Shrimp and Crab Roe Pork Wonton, Yuen Kee has earned a strong reputation for flavor and craftsmanship. The brand has grown to over 4,000 locations worldwide, expanding to international markets like Singapore in 2024, where it continues to receive high praise. Rooted in tradition and driven by passion, Yuen Kee remains committed to celebrating dumpling culture while giving back to the community.

We aspire to be the leading brand of Traditional Cantonese TongSui, a modern emblem where wellness seamlessly meets Southern Chinese culture.

description: Discover Hakka Bond 客家帮 —where age-old Hakka traditions are reimagined for today’s adventurous palate. Step inside a sleek, modern dining space and fuel your curiosity with our Nanyang-style hakka classics: vibrant Lei Cha, artisanal Yong Tau Foo, and aromatic Rice Wine Chicken. Each dish is crafted with bold authenticity, fresh Singapore flair, and premium house twists you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re a heritage foodie or a flavour explorer, Hakka Bond is your invitation to connect, taste, and create new food memories at Funan. Welcome to a new bond—one bite at a time.

description:
Founded in 2014, Roborock creates smart cleaning technology designed to make modern living easier and more enjoyable. Combining innovative design with exceptional performance, Roborock’s range of robot vacuums and wet & dry vacuums offers powerful cleaning, precise navigation, and effortless convenience, giving you more time to do the things you love.

Visit the Roborock Singapore store at Funan to explore the latest products, see them in action, and discover how Roborock can elevate and simplify everyday cleaning at your home.

Each bowl features our signature seasoned rice and premium ingredients, prepared with care and precision. From tender gyudon to seared salmon aburi, every dish is made fresh to order and designed to satisfy — whether you’re on a quick lunch break or craving a moment of warmth in your day. Discover the art of simplicity, one bowl at a time.

name: First Bowl 壹碗
description: At First Bowl, our journey began with a simple belief: in the rush of modern living, a steaming bowl of white rice is one of the most honest and comforting gifts we can give ourselves. ​ Formerly known as DELIBOWL, founded in 2017 in Singapore, First Bowl was created to bring the warmth of home-style Chinese cooking into everyday life. Our founders, inspired by family kitchens, wanted to make it easy for everyone to enjoy freshly cooked dishes with perfectly steamed rice, any day of the week. ​ “First” is more than a name. It means beginning, priority, and intention. We aspire to be your first choice every day—a familiar taste of home and the comfort of your neighborhood kitchen.
